protocol.build_normalization: Benchmark workspaces only: fixed SvelteKit version.name=ci-381-afba0f41 (default is Date.now), identical in all modes. Production frontend config unchanged. Full normal builds remain timed; verify identical binary after each build.
order: baseline-4 (additional baseline after preserved baseline-2 fixture failure)
protocol.cpu_policy: Four CPUs per job, three workers. Baseline and app use the same four CPUs; audits use four other CPUs concurrently. Eight CPUs total for candidate, four for baseline. Models two independent CI runners; does not claim 30% less compute. Shared host remains unreserved.
protocol.build: normal integrated build each job, all workspaces warmed before series
protocol.isolation: Three separate source workspaces; project/worker books, ports, stub ports, output and timing dirs independent. All dependency directories shared read-only. No live providers.
protocol.baseline: Original scheduling and networkidle waits, with identical reporter/named steps/harness controls and shared wrapper. E2E_SUITE=all.
protocol.candidate: Separate CI app/audits groups, worker-scoped sweep seeds, precise request/font/render readiness. Same cases, assertions, application inputs and native SQLite settings.
protocol.scope: Local full wrapper critical-path and total job runner minutes; hosted Actions setup/downloads and queueing are not measured. Local candidate jobs actually overlap on the same shared host.

resumptions.reason: Session interruption; driver had stopped after original baseline-2 MFA previous-step boundary refusal. Runtime inputs unchanged. Retain failure, run candidate-2, baseline-3, candidate-3 and a replacement baseline-4 for three successful baseline samples.
